Leather Winter Gloves

<!--Product Code:--> 0259346360

  • Description

Heavy Duty Winter Snow Gloves. Using high grade sheep skin with keystone thumb. Electronically warmed inserts for extreme cold. Acrylic fur lining ,shirred elastic on back, Leather hemmed cuff with zipper inserted at cuff for easy opening. Compatible to be used with touchscreen devices.

Winter gloves are very suitable as camping, skiing, commuting, snow removal, logging, mountain climbing and other winter activities. Suitable for men and women.
